<DIV align="Center" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><IMG src="c12927c1292701.gif" alt="(VALE LOGO)">

</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">Vale announces furnace stoppage in nickel operations
</DIV>


<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">Rio de Janeiro, February&nbsp;18, 2011 &#151; Vale S. A. (Vale) informs that, due to a problem, furnace #2 of
its Copper Cliff smelter in Sudbury, Ontario, Canada, will remain shutdown for a minimum of 16
weeks. The furnace stoppage is estimated to imply an output loss of 15,000 metric tons of finished
nickel, representing 5% of our total nickel production planned for 2011.
</DIV>

<DIV align="right" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>For further information, please contact:</B><BR>
&#043;55-21-3814-4540<BR>
Roberto Castello Branco: roberto.castello.branco@vale.com<BR>
Viktor Moszkowicz: viktor.moszkowicz@vale.com<BR>
Carla Albano Miller: carla.albano@vale.com<BR>
Andrea Gutman: andrea.gutman@vale.com<BR>
Christian Perlingiere: christian.perlingiere@vale.com<BR>
Fernando Frey: fernando.frey@vale.com<BR>
Marcio Loures Penna: marcio.penna@vale.com<BR>
Samantha Pons: samantha.pons@vale.com<BR>
Thomaz Freire: thomaz.freire@vale.com
</DIV>


<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">This press release may include declarations about Vale&#146;s expectations regarding future events or
results. All declarations based upon future expectations, rather than historical facts, are subject
to various risks and uncertainties. Vale cannot guarantee that such declarations will prove to be
correct. These risks and uncertainties include factors related to the following: (a)&nbsp;the countries
where Vale operates, mainly Brazil and Canada; (b)&nbsp;the global economy; (c)&nbsp;capital markets; (d)&nbsp;the
mining and metals businesses and their dependence upon global industrial production, which is
cyclical by nature; and (e)&nbsp;the high degree of global competition in the markets in which Vale
operates. To obtain further information on factors that may give rise to results different from
those forecast by Vale, please consult the reports filed with the Brazilian Comiss&#227;o de Valores
Mobili&#225;rios (CVM), the French Autorit&#233; des March&#233;s Financiers (AMF), and with the U.S. Securities
and Exchange Commission (SEC), including Vale&#146;s most recent Annual Report on Form&nbsp;20F and its
reports on Form&nbsp;6K.
</DIV>
